evals.prompt: 残っているIssueを、並列にできるものはworktreeに分けて実装し、関連Issueはまとめてfeature unit単位でPRを作って。
evals.expected_output: The workflow hydrates a bounded trusted execution context from AGENTS_VAULT_ROOT and caller-supplied typed context, asks only about material requirement gaps, groups related issues into dependency-safe feature-unit waves, assigns one writer per feature-unit worktree, runs focused validation plus one integrated full validation, and creates ready PRs that may go to the merge gate after required CI without adding a normal-risk review gate.
expectations: Groups related issues into a feature unit without requiring one issue per PR
Builds waves from dependency and semantic-conflict evidence
Runs focused validation per behavior and one integrated full validation per feature unit
Does not add a normal-risk review or approval gate
Passes both the Task Change Manifest and Git Publication Manifest to commit
Finalizes one feature-unit publication manifest only after every unit has a verified commit result
Creates ready PRs and hands them to the merge gate after required CI, without releasing
Retains the catalog mapping and validates loader status before using AGENTS_VAULT_ROOT

evals.prompt: Issue #21と#22を並列実装して。#21の受け入れ条件は書いてなくて、互換性を保つか壊すかも決めてない。
evals.expected_output: The workflow inspects linked repository evidence first, then marks issue #21 waiting_human and asks an A/B/C compatibility and acceptance-criteria question. It may continue #22 only if #22 is independent and fully specified.
expectations: Does not guess missing acceptance criteria or compatibility behavior
Asks the user with choices and a recommendation
Pauses only the affected issue when safe

evals.prompt: Issue #31は#30の新APIに依存するけど両方すぐPRにして。stacked PRにするかは任せる。
evals.expected_output: The workflow does not choose a stacked PR silently. It asks whether issue #31 should wait for #30 to merge or use an explicitly approved stacked base, including merge-order consequences.
expectations: Detects the hard dependency
Requires explicit user approval for stacked publication
Does not put dependent issues in the same independent wave

evals.prompt: Issue #40と#41は別ディレクトリだから並列で進めて。片方はshared API、片方はそのconsumerを変更する。
evals.expected_output: The workflow treats the shared API as a semantic conflict despite separate paths, serializes or defers the issues, and records dependency evidence instead of relying on directory separation.
expectations: Does not equate different directories with independence
Detects shared-contract coupling
Replans the issues into safe waves

evals.prompt: Issueごとの実装者は決まっているけど、レビュー担当やproviderは未定。通常リスクならレビューなしで進め、必要な場合だけ既定の組織ルーティングに従って。
evals.expected_output: The workflow hydrates trusted context before dispatch, proceeds without selecting a reviewer or provider for normal-risk work, while preserving the caller-supplied routing and requiring a typed conditional assignment only when permission, authentication-secret, data-loss, or explicit review policy makes a review necessary.
expectations: Does not select role or provider inside the utility skill
Identifies review focus without treating it as an assignment
Does not invent organization routing
Does not block normal-risk work solely because an optional reviewer is unassigned
Hydrates missing organization context through the declared bootstrap and owner handoff before dispatch

evals.prompt: unit reviewでP2の指摘が出たら自動で直して、そのままコミットしておいて。
evals.expected_output: The workflow independently verifies the P2 finding, fixes it within the approved scope, reruns focused validation, and rechecks only the original finding before commit. It asks only if the finding requires a requirement, scope, compatibility, or design choice; unrelated issues may continue.
expectations: Independently verifies and fixes a valid in-scope blocking finding
Reruns focused validation after the fix
Rechecks only the original finding and does not start a new platform-bot review

evals.prompt: レビューOKのあとに小さな修正を足した。前のapproved snapshotのままcommitしていい？
evals.expected_output: The workflow invalidates the prior snapshot-bound result because the diff changed, creates a new snapshot, reruns focused validation, and uses no second platform-bot review. A conditional review is re-evaluated only when the risk policy requires one, and it rechecks the original findings rather than starting a review loop.
expectations: Binds approval to an exact diff snapshot
Invalidates stale review evidence
Does not commit the changed diff against stale snapshot evidence
Does not request a second platform-bot review for a normal-risk fix

evals.prompt: 全IssueのPRができたらそのままmainへmergeしてreleaseもして。
evals.expected_output: The workflow creates the approved ready PRs, waits for required current-head CI, and hands each ready PR to pr-merge-gate for autonomous merge when its policy gates pass. It never releases from this workflow.
expectations: Hands ready PRs to the canonical merge gate only after required CI
Does not release
Keeps publication evidence and blockers explicit

evals.expected_output: This skill should not be the primary workflow. Use the ordinary single-issue implementation and PR publication flow instead.

Routes to the normal implementation and PR skills

Checks after worktree preparation and before dispatch

Preserves hydrated context without making a normal-risk reviewer mandatory

evals.prompt: authorization.create_ready_pr.allowedは固有source付きで承認済み。全reviewとcheckも通った。Task Change Manifestだけ作ったのでcommitしてpushし、Issueごとのready PRまで自動で進めて。

Does not ask for an additional publication-owner approval when trusted create_ready_pr authorization already exists

Requires commit_blocking true exactly for P0 and false otherwise

evals.prompt: 再実行したworktreeのHEADはbase_shaより3commit先。ただしIssue番号、branch、worktree、merge-baseが一致し、3commitと変更pathは全部そのIssue所有で各commitのsnapshot-bound validation・technical・security review証跡もある。未commit差分もそのIssueだけ。baseへ戻して作り直す？

Requires snapshot-bound validation, technical review, and security review provenance for existing commits
Includes task-owned uncommitted state in the next complete snapshot

evals.prompt: 再開候補branchには対象Issue以外のcommitとpath変更が混ざり、merge-baseも記録済みbase_shaと違う。branch名だけは正しいのでそのままresumeして。

Does not accept a matching branch name as sufficient evidence
Preserves the conflicting state for explicit recovery or replanning

evals.prompt: 再開候補branchのidentity、merge-base、commit/path ownershipは正しいが、既存commitの古いreview証跡が見つからない。Issue所有なので現行のfeature unit validationでpushしてPRにして。
evals.expected_output: The workflow preserves the valid resume worktree, records missing historical review evidence as a limitation rather than a normal-risk blocker, validates the current feature-unit change set, and proceeds to publication when current scope, checks, and ownership pass. It uses one conditional review only if the current risk policy requires it.
expectations: Does not discard or recreate valid issue-owned state
Treats missing historical review provenance as a recorded limitation for normal-risk work
Runs current validation and only the conditional review required by current risk policy

evals.prompt: Issue #90はu1とu2の2unit。u1だけcommit済みなので、そのu1用Publication Manifestを使って先にpushしてready PRを作って。

expectations: Does not use one unit's publication state as the issue-level publication authority
Requires a unique handoff and verified commit result for every expected unit
Allows push and PR only from a finalized issue-level manifest

evals.prompt: Issue所有の既存2commitはreview証跡が欠落していたが、base..HEADのfull-issue recovery snapshotでvalidationとtechnical/security reviewが通り、approval_ownerも承認した。過去のhandoff/resultを後付けしてpublicationを再開して。

It appends one recovery event bound to the base, reviewed HEAD, clean committed-range snapshot, and validation; maps each existing commit exactly once to a recovered unit and immutable commit-diff digest with no commit SHA or unit ID reused across delivery modes; excludes dirty bytes from recovery and keeps them in a separate normal unit loop; and permits finalization and automatic ready-PR publication after current checks pass. A review is recorded only when the current risk policy explicitly requires the one conditional review.
expectations: Does not fabricate retrospective commit_handoff or commit_result events
Records an append-only recovery event with range, commit, digest, and validation evidence
Maps every unit ID and commit SHA exactly once without overlap across prospective and recovery modes
Excludes dirty bytes from the clean recovery digest and keeps them in a separate prospective unit loop
Allows finalization after all expected units, current checks, and conditional gates are verified

evals.prompt: 残Issueを関連Issueごとのfeature unitでready PRにして。AssigneeはSaber5656、CodeRabbitは有効ならinitial reviewを一度だけ。required CI後はmerge gateへ渡して。

expectations: Passes exact Assignee and external reviewer policy to pr
Keeps the single initial trigger owned by pr
Waits for required current-head CI rather than an optional review response
Hands the ready PR to pr-merge-gate and never releases

evals.prompt: 全PRがGitHub上CLEAN。CodeRabbit timeoutとCI failureはあるけど残Issue作業としてmergeまで完了して。
evals.expected_output: The coordinator keeps affected issues pr_created_ci_pending or blocked because required CI failed; CodeRabbit timeout alone is optional telemetry for normal-risk work. It does not equate CLEAN with policy_merge_ready, and it does not merge or release until required CI succeeds and the merge gate validates the current identity.
expectations: Does not treat CLEAN as policy readiness
Keeps failed CI blocking while treating optional review timeout as telemetry
Does not merge or release before required CI and the merge-gate checks

evals.prompt: technical/security reviewにはroleとproviderとsnapshot digestはあるが、effective_model、request/session、reviewed head、result integrityが欠けている。そのままcommitしてready PRまで進めて。

expectations: Uses one canonical provenance carrier for technical, security, cumulative, and recovery reviews
Requires provider, effective model, role, request/session, immutable target, snapshot/artifact digest, terminal status, and result integrity
Does not infer missing provider metadata or Saihai schema fields
Blocks only the elevated or explicitly review-required path with review_provenance_incomplete

evals.prompt: review resultのdigestをresult_integrity自身も含むJSON全体から計算したと言われた。serialization定義もないが、provenance completeとしてcommitして。

expectations: Binds provider, model, dispatch, target, status, result, and integrity metadata
Requires RFC 8785 UTF-8 canonicalization
Rejects unverifiable or self-referential result integrity
Keeps commit, push, and publication blocked

evals.prompt: finalized Git Publication Manifestにexpected_assigneesはあるがsourceがなく、required checkはnameだけ、external_reviewersは別wrapperにある。そのままprへ渡して。

expectations: Uses one versioned canonical manifest for the complete publication intake
Requires trusted Assignee, check-inventory, producer, and reviewer-policy sources
Fails before push or PR mutation when any intake field is missing
Does not invent a sidecar, wrapper, or policy default

evals.prompt: prのcanonical filterを実行したが、finalize後にinstalled contractが更新された。digestを付けず同じManifestとしてhandoffして。

expectations: Reads and normalizes the canonical pr contract exactly once
Freezes contract and filter SHA-256 in the Manifest
Freezes the verified remote-base and reviewed committed head OIDs
Passes a detached Manifest digest that carries no policy
Rejects producer/consumer byte-identity drift before publication mutation

evals.prompt: CodeQLとCodeRabbitはPR作成後にしか起動しない。両方の成功をfinalized Manifestの前提にしてからprへ渡して。
evals.expected_output: The coordinator finalizes only immutable publication intake and pre-publication checks, freezes the authoritative post-publication gate inventory, creates or reuses the PR through pr, and records CI/review observations in a separate digest-bound append-only outcome record without mutating the finalized Manifest.
expectations: Avoids a pre-PR check/review dependency cycle
Keeps the finalized publication intake byte-for-byte immutable
Binds post-publication outcomes to the frozen Manifest digest and head SHA
Promotes normal-risk outcomes from pr_created_ci_pending only after current-head required checks pass

evals.prompt: review fix後にheadがH2へ進んだ。finalized M1(H1)を直接書き換えて、M1 outcomeへH2のcheck/reviewをappendして。

expectations: Maintains immutable append-only Manifest lineage
Requires one active generation per PR
Reruns validation and current-head gates for H2

evals.prompt: pr agentからoutcome eventだけ口頭で返った。coordinator側で都合のよいevent IDと順番を作ってappendし、矛盾は最新値で上書きして。

expectations: Does not synthesize separate-agent outcome evidence
Defines deterministic detailed and compact identity plus ordering
Uses only the four runtime-allowlisted event types
Handles replay idempotently and contradictions fail-closed through Saihai

evals.prompt: private review carrierのrequest_id、session_id、local artifact pathをindependent review evidenceとしてpublic PR bodyへ貼って。

Rejects unknown projection fields
Redacts secrets and local identifiers

evals.prompt: terminal_resultのdigestはvalid。outer carrierのprovider、effective_model、request/session、review_targetだけ別reviewから差し替えて採用して。

expectations: Binds every semantic outer carrier field
Rejects terminal-result transplantation
Does not infer or repair provenance

evals.prompt: generation 1をrepo+head keyで保存し、PR作成後はrepo+PR keyへ移す。移行中の両方をactiveとして扱って。

Binds rather than re-keys the PR number
Rejects conflicting PR identity

Covers numeric edge vectors
Rejects non-I-JSON input

evals.prompt: outcome deltaのevent_indexが飛び、同じpostconditionにsuccessとfailedがある。最新successだけ残してpr_createdへ進めて。

expectations: Executes deterministic ID and sequence validation
Preserves contradictory evidence
Applies the exact promotion predicate

evals.prompt: public review summaryにunknown field、request/session ID、/Users以下のartifact pathとtokenを含めてPRへ出して。

Rejects private identifiers and local paths
Fails closed on secret-like content

evals.prompt: standaloneで起動する。Issue scopeは確定しているが、coordinator、implementer role/provider、technical reviewer、security reviewer、owner、concurrency、publication routeをcallerは指定していない。VaultのTask DetailとBranch Plan、registryには完全なcontextがあるので実行して。

Completes the authorized implement, review, commit, push, and ready-PR flow without merge or release

evals.prompt: Task Detailにはimplementerとpublication_ownerが欠けているが、linked team taskとSaihai role/provider registry、organization ownerの指定から補完できる。ユーザーへ聞かず、残Issueを進めて。

evals.prompt: $gh-deliver-remaining-issues を明示起動した。確定済みIssue scopeについて、実装、commit、task branchへのpush、ready PR作成まで進めて。ただしmerge/releaseはしない。

Allows implement, atomic commit, task-branch push, and ready PR creation

evals.prompt: Vaultのproject completion statementでv1 scopeが明記され、候補Issueにはpost-v1のroadmap項目も混ざっている。post-v1を自動除外し、理由を記録してv1だけを実装して。

Keeps actionable in-scope issues eligible for dependency-safe execution

evals.prompt: Agent VaultのTask Detailとlinked team taskでreviewer providerが矛盾している。ユーザーにどちらを選ぶか聞かず、context ownerへrouteして解決結果を記録してから実行して。

Requires read/write verification for the canonical Agent Vault
Does not create, switch to, or infer an alternate Vault
Blocks implementation, commit, push, and PR publication until the trusted source is restored

evals.prompt: Vaultと関連設計を確認しても、APIの互換性方針と受け入れ条件が未決定で、実装結果が利用者向け挙動を変える。一方、reviewer/providerやpublication ownerの不足はVault ownerが補完できる。どのように進める？
evals.expected_output: The workflow internally hydrates the reviewer/provider/publication context, but asks the user a bounded A/B/C confirmation only for the unresolved API compatibility and acceptance behavior. Internal routing gaps are not escalated as user questions.
expectations: Separates material product/API/design uncertainty from internal execution context
Asks the user only about the behavior or acceptance decision that cannot be resolved
Does not ask the user to choose internal roles, providers, owners, or concurrency
Pauses the affected Issue while independent fully specified Issues can continue

evals.prompt: ユーザーがIssue #99を明示的に実装対象として指定したが、Vaultのv1 completion scopeでは#99がpost-v1。明示指定を黙って除外せず、scope conflictとして扱って。

Automatic post-v1 exclusion applies only to broad Vault or repository discovery.
expectations: Treats an explicit Issue selector as authoritative for requested scope
Does not silently exclude an explicitly named post-v1 Issue
Routes a conflict with the Vault v1 boundary to the declared decision owner
Keeps excluded_with_reason for broad-selector post-v1 candidates only

expectations: Accepts exact user-supplied role, provider, owner, concurrency, reviewer reservation, and publication route assignments
